description: This Java class implements a CommandResponseSender, which manages sending command response messages over an AMQP link in the Eclipse Hono client. It handles creating the sender link, sending messages, and managing the messaging flow with features like span tracing and target address formatting.

classes.name: CommandResponseSenderImpl
classes.description: A class that implements CommandResponseSender to send command responses via an AMQP link, using Vert.x Proton and OpenTracing for tracing.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for an outcome, with tracing span.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific recipient addressing logic implemented.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string for command responses.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for its delivery outcome.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Overloaded method to send a message with a specific SpanContext for tracing.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address string for a given tenant and reply ID.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Converts a CommandResponse to a Message, assigns address, and sends it, returning a Future of the delivery.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CommandResponseSender with specified connection, tenant, replyId, setting flow latency if below default, and handling link creation.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Begins a new OpenTracing span for forwarding command responses, with client span kind.
